decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-4466342a0636] names the subject: the `deletionPolicy` field on namespaced managed resources, which are net new in v2. It states the change: the field is removed. It also states the scope: existing cluster-scoped managed resources are not affected, so only namespaced managed resources are exposed. It names the replacement: to get the old behaviour, set `managementPolicies: ["Create", "Observe", "Update"]`, leaving out "Delete". That is enough to write the consequence as "the deletionPolicy option is not available on namespaced MRs; use managementPolicies instead". The excerpt does not say whether a manifest that still sets `deletionPolicy` is rejected or ignored, so my confidence is low.
